recording: Continuous actual browser screen recording; no mocked OCR or changed playback speed. Reading pauses are included.
tooling_reuse: Shiftproof Playwright CLI orchestration pattern only; no Shiftproof product code.

scenes.title: Recorded walkthrough · A fictional screenshot
scenes.detail: Actual browser actions and local scans. Pauses give you time to read.

scenes.title: 1 · Choose an image
scenes.detail: This example and its contact details are fictional. Source pixels stay in browser memory.

scenes.title: Scan for English email and phone lines
scenes.detail: This step uses real local OCR. The recording pauses after completion so you can review.

scenes.title: 2 · Review the suggested masks
scenes.detail: Recognised email and phone lines are selected. You can keep or remove each mask.

scenes.title: Every suggestion is your choice
scenes.detail: Toggling the phone suggestion changes the mask. It is selected again for this export.

scenes.title: Add details the scan does not cover
scenes.detail: The badge code is outside supported patterns. A manual rectangle covers it.

scenes.title: Look at the whole image
scenes.detail: Names, faces, addresses, QR codes and missed text all require manual review.

scenes.title: 3 · Confirm your review
scenes.detail: The review checkbox is required. Any mask edit resets this acknowledgement.

scenes.title: Create a fresh PNG and check its actual pixels
scenes.detail: Opaque masks are flattened into the output. Real OCR scans that exported image.

scenes.title: Inspect the exported preview
scenes.detail: This real output contains the selected masks. The check found zero supported patterns here.

scenes.title: Download the checked PNG
scenes.detail: A new image is downloaded with a neutral filename, rather than the source file.

scenes.title: The same OCR can miss the same detail twice
scenes.detail: A zero result is not a privacy guarantee. Check the full image before sharing.

export_result_text: Export check completed: no supported email or phone pattern was recognised in the output. This is not a privacy guarantee; inspect the preview before downloading.
caption_method: Caption PNG panels rendered with Pillow and composed below the unchanged browser screen using ffmpeg. No playback speed changes.
encoding_tool: imageio-ffmpeg0.6.0 / bundled ffmpeg7.0.2; Pillow12.1.1; local DejaVu fonts
